title: New deployments reach reviewed tiers and client files.
subtitle: P70 is an administrative change, not an inference service. Discovery and review are read-only; device distribution remains explicit.

nodes.title: 1 - Read the selected estate
lines: Foundry deployments: name, model, version, SKU, capacity and state.
Gateway backend and model lists; governance ownership.
Existing record and dated private price book.

nodes.title: 2 - Review once
lines: [[flow]] or [[sync]]
[[plan]]
Per-deployment tier choices; missing keep/drop.
Fingerprint binds state, prices and outputs.

nodes.title: 3 - Recheck before writing
lines: [[ownership]]
Turnstile-owned tiers refuse apply.
[[snapshot]]
Snapshot before the local run journal.

nodes.title: 4 - Two Azure values only
lines: [[standard]]
[[premium]]
Fail-loud writes and exact readback.
No membership, quota or policy write.
Real requests measure propagation; readback is not data-plane proof.

nodes.title: 5 - Record and prices
lines: Allowed live deployment union; actual model/version.
Per-tier lists; client overrides preserved.
[[prices]]
Dated exact mappings; historical prices stay.
Unknown rate is unpriced, never free.

nodes.title: 6 - Tier-specific handover
lines: [[profiles]]
Standard and premium MDM payloads.
One workstation record per tier.
Newest family pins and capability declarations.
[[code]] and [[desktop]]

nodes.title: Existing fleet and developer routes
lines: Administrator assigns Intune, Jamf or Group Policy payloads.
Developer reruns the existing setup with the tier record.
User settings and VS Code model variables are refreshed.
The record itself grants no entitlement.

nodes.title: Explicit boundaries
lines: No remote workstation change or Foundry deployment.
No cross-service transaction: failure stops and a new plan reads actual state.
Empty lists mean allow all; last-entry removal is refused.
Saved-query and scheduled-reconciler tariff publication stay separate.

notice: No new Azure component is required by model sync. The existing gateway remains the inference enforcer; generated files are distributed through the existing fleet and workstation processes.
